name: rego-adventure-frontend
description: Policy-Based Access Control Adventure - Frontend Dependencies
author: Mario Enrico Ragucci

comments.purpose: This package.json carries the frontend's two dependency surfaces: "dependencies" are the browser libraries the game loads via CDN, "devDependencies" are the Node toolchains for tests, lint and QA.
comments.deployment: Dependencies are loaded via CDN using Import Maps (see index.html/importmap.json).
comments.security: Run 'npm audit --omit=dev' to audit the shipped browser libraries (the CI merge gate); 'npm audit --omit=prod' reports advisories for the CI toolchain without gating.
comments.updates: Use 'npm outdated' to check for available updates, then update versions in package.json and regenerate the import map in index.html with cmd/importmapgen (do not edit the import map by hand).
comments.importmap: The import map is generated from "dependencies" only. The optional 'importmap.subpaths' field declares package subpath modules per dependency; importmapgen emits an extra '<lib>/<subpath>' entry for each. Declare subpaths here when a new import path is used in frontend code.
comments.testing: Run 'npm test' after 'npm ci' in this directory: the toolchains are devDependencies pinned by the committed lockfile, the same install every frontend CI job starts from.
